nodes.reason: deferred in test profile: expensive model, returns when fees fund inference

decisions.note: history as stored by the engine; cost fields appear only when the AI layer records them

budget.arena_shrunk_reason: budget: 90% of daily 3500000 = 3150000 micro fits 9 models (48 tokens/h x 24 x avg reserve 211 micro + ensemble); ceiling 14

selection.funded_empty_reason: all_models_losing_after_costs: nobody promoted (the least-bad model is never funded)
selection.rule: promotable iff lcb(model - every frozen baseline) > 0 (Bonferroni over m_eff) and mean>0 after costs and both walk-forward halves > 0

evaluation.rule: after the epoch every champion/selection/promotion uses only evidence whose entry/decision observation id > evaluation_epoch; older evidence is kept, displayed and labelled pre_epoch_contaminated

real.label: REAL
real.basis: on-chain fills of the live executor, realized PnL in native ETH
real.fills_reason: executor not armed for real orders (dry-run or disarmed): fills are virtual
real.win_rate_reason: executor does not expose per-trade outcomes
real.sample_note: No real fills to judge: sample size is zero or unverified.

simulated.label: SIMULATED
simulated.basis: paper books against quoted prices; no order exists
simulated.unit: paper micro-units of the paper book (not ETH, not USD)
simulated.pnl_usd_reason: paper units are not convertible to USD

performance.note: Real and simulated figures are never combined.

burns.reason: No burn program (buyback disabled by Founder decision)

inference.reason: no inference allocation recorded yet (no claim ledgered)

trading.reason: no trading allocation recorded yet (no claim ledgered)

legend.observed: read-only chain/API read, not income, not receipt-validated
legend.dry_run: planned by a dry-run tick; nothing was sent or ledgered
legend.proven: backed by receipt-validated, hash-chained ledger rows (None when there are none)

funding.reason: token pending: all funding values are null until proven

inference_funding.reason: treasury reports no inference funding data (token pending)

methodology: REAL = on-chain fills by the live executor (ETH, USD at the stated rate). SIMULATED = paper books. The AI layer is experimental. Nothing here is financial advice.
